data.narrative:
Quantinuum is a Series G quantum computing company founded by Ilyas Khan, currently valued at $14.8B post-money following $2.7B+ in total capital raised. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of five same-sector peers spanning both public and private stages: IonQ ($13.0B public), PsiQuantum ($7.0B private), D-Wave Quantum ($6.3B public), SandboxAQ ($5.8B Series E), and Rigetti Computing ($4.5B public). This peer set establishes a sector range of $4.5B to $13.0B.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis applied a typical 1.25x Series G step-up multiplier to the $14.8B last post-money valuation, implying $18.5B. Peer-median analysis across the five comparables produced a median valuation of $6.3B, reflecting the wide dispersion within the quantum computing sector at present valuations. The peer range spans $4.5B (low) to $13.0B (high).

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $5.3B (low) to $21.2B (high), with a median of $12.4B. The substantial width of this range—spanning roughly 4x from low to high—reflects material uncertainty in quantum computing fundamentals and peer comparability. Quantinuum's current $14.8B valuation sits above the peer median, positioning it in the upper quartile of the comp set. Key uncertainties include technology differentiation relative to IonQ and PsiQuantum, path to commercial revenue, and the liquidity discount embedded in private peer valuations.
